sentences.text: Stanley Tucci -LRB- -LSB- ˈtuːtʃi -RSB- -LSB- ˈtuttʃi -RSB- ; born November 11 , 1960 -RRB- is an American character actor , writer , producer and film director .

Tucci was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for his performance in The Lovely Bones -LRB- 2009 -RRB- .	Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor	Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor	The Lovely Bones	The Lovely Bones (film)
He won two Emmy Awards for his performances in Winchell and Monk .	Emmy Awards	Primetime Emmy Award	Winchell	Winchell (film)	Monk	Monk (TV series)
He was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Spoken Word Album for Children , for The One and Only Shrek !	Grammy Award	Grammy Award
